description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It is used to manage large or time-consuming tasks in a non-blocking manner within a React application, specifically for expanding tree nodes or similar batch operations.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, with start and cancel capabilities, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) and provides methods to start processing from a list of items or cancel ongoing processing.
